thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: service=hosted-inference-prod severity=P1 — high 5xx rate detected (rolling 1m). Escalation policy 'pagerflow-main'. Incident link: https://pagerduty.internal/incidents/PD-89012. Triggered at 2024-05-22T02:05:01Z

derrick: just got the page, I'm on it. Checking error rates & recent deploys. ping me if customers are actively reporting.

derrick: quick look — spikes coming from inference-pool-3, approx 18% 5xx on /v1/generate, tail latencies climbing. running top & journalctl on node-7.

derrick: logs snippet:
```
2024-05-22T02:04:58Z inference-runtime ERROR kv-cache: failed to load segment: OOMError
2024-05-22T02:05:00Z inference-runtime WARN request id=abc123 latency=1200ms status=500
```

incident-bot: No acknowledgement from primary after 2m. Escalating to secondary: @maria.

maria: sorry, I didn't see the original mobile page — acked now via PD mobile. heading to keyboard. any immediate mitigation I should start?

derrick: thanks — we're seeing large mem churn on the GPU hosts. For now I want a rapid mitigation: disable request batching on pool-3 and route traffic to pool-1 (less loaded). I'll open a temporary route in the console.

sarah: are customers seeing failures? dashboards show 14% errors for production region us-east-1, 95th latency ~1.2s. A subset of customer calls are getting 500s, some degraded outputs. tagging support to watch for tickets.

james: timeline note: autoscaler triggered scale-down ~3m before spike, suspicious. Could be interplay between recent runtime change and small pool sizes.

derrick: doing manual routing now — running:
```bash
# move traffic off pool-3
redwoodctl routing set --service hosted-inference-prod --from pool-3 --to pool-1 --weight 80
```

incident-bot: Manager escalation fired (no secondary ack within escalation window) — paging @helen (manager).

helen: I got manager page and joined. I'm awake, standing up bridge. can someone confirm customer-impact severity?

maria: confirmed — multiple 500s, partial customer impact. Estimate ~10-15% of requests failing across model-serving endpoints. Customers on lower tiers seeing higher latency.

helen: opening ad-hoc Zoom: https://zoom.internal/meet/infra-bridge-89012. Margaret from Support + oncall-SRE looped.

derrick: routing weight updated, started draining pool-3 hosts. will attempt small rollback of last runtime bump if errors persist.

sarah: suggest muting noisy nonblocking alerts so incident signal stays clear. Also enabling temporary cache TTL increase to reduce backend pressure.

maria: acked to PD earlier but now on bridge. I'm running a heap check and will restart the gpu-worker process on node-7 if heap doesn't free.

james: monitoring dashboards: errors trending down to 6% after routing, 95th latency back to ~650ms. still >SLO but improving.

derrick: restarted gpu-worker on node-7, kernel logs showed repeated mmap failures before restart. collecting /proc and core dumps for postmortem.

maria: I confirmed PD mobile ack happened ~90s ago. sorry for delay — poor mobile signal. :grimacing:

helen: thanks team. customers notified? support triage?

sarah: support alerted, sent templated status update to affected customers in US-EAST with initial mitigation note and ETA for follow-up.

incident-bot: Secondary (maria) acknowledged at 1716357920. Manager (helen) acknowledged at 1716357935.

derrick: current state: traffic routed off pool-3, restarted worker, errors down to ~3.5%. Keeping bridge open for 30m to monitor. immediate customer impact reduced but not fully cleared.

helen: good work. blocking action items: (1) collect all logs and core dumps from pool-3 hosts, (2) roll back last runtime change in canary, (3) run autoscaler diagnostic against current metrics, (4) postmortem drafted tomorrow. I'll assign owners in the post-incident doc.

maria: I'll take heap/core collection and add notes. planning follow-up hotfix for kernel mmap edge case with runtime team.

james: I'll check autoscaler config and revise scale-down threshold to avoid oscillation.

derrick: temporary mitigation complete. leaving a sticky note in console with rollback flags & link to bridge. once we confirm stable I'll start a canary of the previous runtime build.

sarah: Support will keep customer updates in cadence. asking for final incident severity classification after postmortem.

helen: agreed. set severity=P1 for now due to customer-visible errors and manager wakeup. We'll reclassify post-incident if needed.

maria: update — core dump upload complete to artifact store: https://artifacts.internal/hosted-inference/pd-89012/cores.

derrick: thanks. closing bridge in 30m if stable. follow-ups: postmortem, autoscaler tuning, runtime mmap hotfix.

helen: thanks all. great quick coordination. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-89012 status changed to 'under control' at 2024-05-22T02:12:39Z. Postmortem owner: helen.

derrick: filing initial incident notes for postmortem — will add timeline and links.

maria: thanks team — catching up on sleep now, ping if anything else comes up.

james: monitoring will continue for next 2 hours.

sarah: closing customer comms loop after final confirm.
